**Meet the official media partners of WordCamp Asia 2026!** Carefully selected from dozens of applications, these media outlets will help us connect with our diverse audience and sponsors across the globe.

Our media partners will share stories and insights from WordCamp Asia 2026 and publish a wide range of content, including articles, videos, podcasts, and interviews.

Follow them for full coverage before, during, and after the event.

## TheWPWeekly

The WP Weekly is an email newsletter for WordPress professionals sharing the best bits from the WordPress ecosystem in a concise way that should take at most 10 minutes of reading time.

Ideal for WordPress product creators, freelancers, DIYers, and agency owners to stay updated. Learn about the latest project launches, tools, plugin updates, new features, and core WordPress updates every week.

Also, track various online and offline events for WordPress learning and connections. Stay informed on the business side of WordPress with new acquisitions, investments, and deals on different WordPress products.

## WPSimplified

**WPSimplified** is your go-to place for learning WordPress without the stress or confusion. Led by industry expert **Sunil Kumar Sharma**, the platform breaks down complex web development topics into simple, practical steps anyone can follow, whether you are just starting out or working toward becoming a professional developer.

From building your first website to fixing technical issues or even launching a career in tech, WPSimplified offers clear tutorials, hands-on training, and real-world career guidance. It bridges the gap between feeling stuck and feeling confident, helping you create polished, professional digital experiences with ease. Join a growing community of learners and start unlocking your potential today. Because at WPSimplified, WordPress is made simple, practical, and profitable.

## Abhay Kulkarni

Abhay Kulkarni is the Co-founder of Jeevonix, an AI Solutions Agency based in India, and India’s first n8n Ambassador. With deep expertise in AI, automation, and WordPress, he focuses on designing practical, real-world systems that help businesses, creators, and teams save time, reduce operational friction, and scale sustainably.

Through his YouTube channel and private community, Abhay creates educational content centered on AI workflows, no-code and low-code automation, WordPress integrations, and real implementation-driven use cases. His approach emphasizes clarity, experimentation, and long-term value over short-lived hype. The audience engaging with his content includes developers, founders, marketers, and WordPress professionals who actively apply these learnings in production environments.

As a media partner, Abhay brings thoughtful event coverage, technical depth, and community-first storytelling to platforms like WordCamp Asia – connecting the WordPress ecosystem with the evolving landscape of automation and AI-powered workflows.

## WP-CONTENT.CO

WP-CONTENT.CO is an independent, WordPress-focused media platform committed to delivering credible, timely, and insightful coverage of the global WordPress ecosystem.

We report on core development, plugins, themes, security, performance, hosting, and community initiatives, while also highlighting the people and organizations shaping the future of WordPress.

Our platform serves developers, agencies, product makers, and enthusiasts who rely on us to stay informed. We also publish a widely read WP Week Newsletter that curates the most important WordPress updates in one place. To make staying informed even easier, we also produce a podcast version of the newsletter — perfect for busy professionals who prefer to listen on the go.

</div>

## WPVaat Gujarati Podcast

WPVaat Gujarati Podcast was initiated in the year 2023 with an intention to spread knowledge, trends, fundamentals & strategies about WordPress. So far, we have interviewed 45+ guests from various industries, the WordPress Community & subject-specific experts. We have today each episode published on 25+ podcast platforms.

Our core focus was to promote WordPress knowledge in the Gujarati language to remove the generation gaps between senior citizens, kids, Gen-Z & people above 40+ to connect them through knowledge-sharing under one common thought of learning WordPress together.   

Today, WordPress has been advancing with the latest technologies. Keeping this in mind, we also invite industry experts to talk about challenges, trends, and how people can progress using WordPress within that industry.

## Digital Marketing Tamil

DigitalMarketingTamil.com is the best Tamil-language authority platform for digital marketing education, founded by Alston Antony, a seasoned SEO expert with over 10 years of experience serving Tamil Nadu businesses from Chennai to Coimbatore. Alston Antony, who has trained 18,000+ students, created 426+ educational videos garnering 400,000+ views, and built a 15,000+ member community, delivers practical guides on SEO, AI tools, WordPress, content marketing, and SaaS strategies tailored for local entrepreneurs.

The site empowers small and medium enterprises with step-by-step tutorials, tool reviews, and real-world case studies in Tamil, helping users boost rankings, traffic, and revenue while bridging global trends with regional needs. As a trusted hub for Tamil-speaking professionals, it fosters sustainable online growth through transparent, data-driven insights.

## Jakson

Jakson occupies the ‘happy space’ between heavy page builders and complex coding, serving as a dedicated resource for freelance builders and website implementers. Targeted at intermediate creators who want to master modern WordPress, the brand focuses deeply on leveraging Core WordPress, Block Themes, and Full Site Editing (FSE).

The philosophy is simple: build high-performance, maintainable websites without relying on bloated plugins. By prioritizing speed, accessibility, and conversions, Jakson demonstrates how to push the native Block Editor to its limits using non-coding techniques. It offers a sustainable path for a global audience looking to create faster, leaner, and future-proof websites using the tools already built into WordPress.

## WPQRST

WPQRST – a part of Riddleman FM, is a podcast series that is all about WordPress Questions, Rockstars, Startups & of course, Talks – hence WPQRST. This podcast was started in order to talk about the wonders of the WordPress Community, right from the people, to events, to great projects and products that are being worked on using WordPress.

The parent platform, Riddleman FM, offers a diverse radio experience, with over 500,000 hours of music and podcasts from 40,000+ radios across 187 countries in 119 genres and 24 languages. It is designed for an audience interested in talk shows, music, and global tech trends, and more. Riddleman FM caters to listeners seeking curated music collections for every mood and activity.

## Dazeinfo

Dazeinfo is an AI-powered market intelligence and research platform built for people who make high-stakes decisions.

We help entrepreneurs, investors, and CXOs cut through noise and identify the signals that actually drive growth – using data, deep research, and continuous market tracking. From uncovering emerging trends to enabling sharper due diligence and competitive intelligence, Dazeinfo turns complex data into clear, actionable insight.

Beyond intelligence, we help growth-stage startups shape perception and build authority. Through data-backed research reports and thought leadership positioning, we enable founders to stand out in crowded markets, earn credibility with investors and customers, and move from being “one of many” to being category-relevant. The outcome is tangible – stronger investor interest, faster trust, and easier conversations around fundraising and enterprise sales.

A curated community of 50,000+ entrepreneurs, investors, and CXOs who rely on insight, not intuition, to stay ahead of the curve.

</div>

## WPoets

WPoets is a WordPress Development Agency based in Pune. They have built hundreds of WordPress-based websites, themes, and plugins. WPoets specialize in designing, building, and maintaining complex SASS Websites. With the Awesome Websites plan, they provide unique continuous improvement activities to marketing teams.

WPoets team has contributed to the WordPress community by sharing knowledge at various WordCamps, reviewing themes, and contributing to Hindi translations. They have hosted some of the local WordPress meetups as well.
